decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - Demolitions shall be carried out carefully and recorded during the process. Work is to be commenced by opening up limited trial areas, particularly the main original front wall, so that any features found, such as original openings can be noted. Sound insulation shall be attached without obliterating these features. A dimension survey verifying the location of the original walls is to be submitted prior to the demolition works being carried out, other than that required for investigation purposes. The local planning authority is to be notified and given the opportunity to inspect.

Condition : 3 - Detailed specifications and samples of materials with drawings of not less than 1:20 shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority prior to the relevant parts of the works being carried out, including windows, new cladding to the wall and roof, fascias, trim, balustrades, rails. The work shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - Before the relevant parts of the works are carried out, detailed specifications shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority of:
(a) repointing (to include a sample area)
(b) pipes to be used including soil/vent and rainwater
(c) internal partitions
A method statement is required showing how the minimum interference to and loss of original fabric of walls and ceiling of the core building is being addressed, to be supported by 1:5 scale explanatory details for proposed noise and thermal insulation. The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - Before the relevant parts of the works are carried out, the structural load path analysis shall be provided, indicating where the changes are taking place. Key transfer points should be expressed in columns and piers, including springings for new openings, and with downstand beams or lintols.

Condition : 6 - The original staircase shall be carefully removed and refurbished, with minimum loss of historic fabric. Details of replacement location and method of fixing is to be provided and approved.

Condition : 7 - Where original walls are within 300mm of proposed walls, "fine tuning" of room layouts to reduce demolition shall be discussed with the L.P.A. and amended by agreement. Any mouldings found around the original openings shall be retained and incorporated into the proposed walls and its finishes.

Condition : 8 - Where original windows are being closed up, their original positions are to be indicated in the wall profile/finishes.

The works shall be completed in accordance with the approved details or as otherwise first agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - Before the relevant part of the development is commenced, the fabric of the existing roof shall be repaired in accordance with a scheme to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be completed in accordance with the submitted details.
description: Conversion of upper floors staff accomodation into 5 mixed one and two bedroom self contained flats incorporating extension to the rear of 2nd floor with internal & external alterations to whole building (LIsted Building Consent)
